name: AR_RECEIVABLES_TRX_ALL_
description: The AR_RECEIVABLES_TRX_ALL table links distribution information with your receivables activities. Possible activity types include Adjustment, Miscellaneous Cash, and Finance Charge. If you select a Miscellaneous Cash activity type, you can associate either a distribution set or a standard accounting flexfield value with your receivables activity. Oracle Receivables uses one row for each activity. The primary key for this table is RECEIVABLES_TRX_ID.

columns.name: GL_ACCOUNT_SOURCE
columns.description: Lookup code for GL_ACCOUNT_SOURCE lookup type. Values include Activity GL Account, Distribution Set, Revenue on Invoice, and Tax Code on Invoice.

columns.name: TAX_CODE_SOURCE
columns.description: Lookup code for TAX_CODE_SOURCE lookup type. Values include Activity, Invoice, and None.

columns.name: TAX_RECOVERABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether tax for this activity is recoverable (not applicable to miscellaneous cash transactions)

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_AFFECT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicates whether entities that are created should be posted to General Ledger

columns.name: RISK_ELIMINATION_DAYS
columns.description: Stores the number of days after maturity that an endorsed bill receivable transaction must be held before the risk can be eliminated.  If left blank, Receivables uses zero (0) days.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.

columns.name: APPLY_PREPAY_PREFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the codes that specify the type of prepayment invoice to apply against a sales invoice. Application types are configured as lookup codes under the ORA_AR_PREPAY_APP_PREFERENCE lookup type.
